caption:
साउथ के सुपरस्टार ममूटी ने बॉक्स ऑफिस पर इतिहास रच दिया है।

दिग्गज अभिनेता ममूटी की फिल्म OM आज पूरी दुनिया में 100 करोड़ के आंकड़े को छूने वाली है।
फिल्म ने अब तक कुल 98.99 करोड़ का वर्ल्डवाइड कलेक्शन कर लिया है।
यह ममूटी के करियर की पहली ऐसी फिल्म है जो 100 करोड़ क्लब में शामिल होगी।
20 नवंबर को रिलीज हुई इस फिल्म में धनुष और साई पल्लवी भी मुख्य भूमिका में हैं।
रिपोर्ट्स के मुताबिक 200 करोड़ के बजट में बनी यह फिल्म धनुष और ममूटी की अब तक की सबसे महंगी फिल्म है।
राजकुमार पेरियासामी द्वारा निर्देशित यह फिल्म लकड़ी की तस्करी पर आधारित है।

क्या आप ममूटी को एक विलेन के रोल में देखने के लिए उत्साहित हैं? 💥🎬🔥

ctx.title: OM Worldwide Box Office: Mammootty Is All Set To Debut In The 100 Crore Club Today!
ctx.summary:
Mammootty's latest film, OM, is all set to enter the 100 crore club globally. This will be his first film to cross the milestone. 
 The post  OM Worldwide Box Office: Mammootty Is All Set To Debut In The 100 Crore Club Today!  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
Mammootty is one of the biggest superstars of Indian cinema. Even after 5 decades, he remains one of the top actors in the country. The actor’s recent film, OM, was released in theatres on November 20. It marked his return to Tamil cinema after 8 years. Despite being a celebrated actor, he has not managed to score a 100-crore grosser at the box office. Well, that changes today.
Mammootty’s latest film, which also stars Dhanush and Sai Pallavi, is inching closer to the 100 crore mark globally. In the film directed by Rajkumar Periyasamy, Mammootty plays the leader of a smuggling ring. Set in Tamil Nadu and Andhra Pradesh, the film, based on real incidents, follows an undercover cop who infiltrates a smuggling gang to reach its main boss.
The film has completed 5 days at the box office and continues to hold well. On its first Tuesday, the film earned 5.4 crore net in India. This was a 14% drop from its first Monday collection. The film has been playing across over 6,000 shows in India. This brings its overall net total to 61.85 crore . Its India gross total stands at 72.98 crore . Overseas, the film has earned 26 crore so far. This takes the film’s worldwide total to 98.99 crore .
The Malayalam superstar has never entered the 100 crore club. His highest-grossing film so far has been the 2022 film Bheeshma Parvam. The film earned 88.5 crore gross globally. Now, 4 years after his highest-grosser, OM has shattered the record. The film is now just 1.01 crore away from hitting the 100 crore milestone. On Wednesday, the film will enter the 100 crore club globally, marking Mammootty’s first film to achieve the milestone.
If reports are to be believed, OM was made on a budget of 200 crore . With such a big budget, it has become Dhanush and Mammootty’s most expensive film ever. The film is centered around wood smuggling, and portions of it are based on true incidents. Sai Pallavi plays a senior police officer tasked with dismantling the smuggling ring led by Mammootty ‘s character, Siya. Dhanush plays an undercover cop in the film, sent to win Siya’s trust. This is a high-stakes action drama that promises an engaging big-screen experience.
